scenarios.name: Ancient Bronze Dragon's flying cannot be blocked by a ground creature
scenarios.ruling: A creature with flying can only be blocked by creatures with flying or reach, so a 2/2 ground blocker is refused and all 7 combat damage reaches the defending player.

scenarios.name: Ancient Bronze Dragon puts a d20 result worth of +1/+1 counters on each of two target creatures
scenarios.ruling: Combat damage to a player triggers the roll; the reflexive trigger then puts X +1/+1 counters on each of up to two target creatures, where X is the result of the one d20 roll, so both targets get the same number of counters. The engine's first roll of a game is 4.

expect.log: rolls a d20 for Ancient Bronze Dragon: 4

scenarios.name: Ancient Bronze Dragon does not roll when its combat damage is dealt to a blocking creature
scenarios.ruling: The ability triggers only on combat damage dealt to a player. Damage dealt to a blocker does not trigger it, so no d20 is rolled and no +1/+1 counters appear.
